recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is; the current source already satisfies the published typo correction and further prose changes would be redundant.
issue_request: FHIR-18157 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 technical correction for FHIR-core Observation asking to remove the extra word in Observation.comment so the text reads "information about its source" rather than "information about the its source".
initial_application: The Jira snapshot cites Eric Haas' 988770c48b application commit. Git history confirms 988770c48b changed the Observation spreadsheet from "information about the its source" to "information about its source", and 835b69e911 later refined the same sentence's grammar before subsequent source refactors carried the corrected text forward.
additional_context: FHIR-17576 is a closely related Published Observation issue that changed STU3 Observation.comment into the current Observation.note element. The active current build maps Observation.comment to Observation.note in source/fhir.ini, and Observation remains an active resource. Searches found no later Jira, Zulip, or Confluence evidence conflicting with the typo correction.
reconciliation: No source edit was needed. source/observation/structuredefinition-Observation.xml already says "information about its source when relevant to its interpretation" for Observation.note, and a source search found no remaining "the its source" wording.

related_jiras.note: Renamed Observation.comment to Observation.note and explains why the current corrected wording is checked on Observation.note rather than a literal Observation.comment element.
